name: US Census Bureau
label: US Census Bureau
description: US Census Bureau official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: census_get, geography_list. Docs: https://www.census.gov/data/developers/guidance/api-user-guide.html. Census Data API (https://api.census.gov/data). A free API key is required for all queries as of 2026 (https://www.census.gov/library/video/2026/adrm/requesting-a-census-data-api-key.html). US Government work is generally public domain plus embargo notes. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One US Census Bureau request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"census_get"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: census_get | geography_list. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'census_get'.

schema.label: dataset
schema.description: Required for census_get and geography_list. Two path segments program/dataset (e.g. dec/sf1, acs/acs5). Single segment like dec returns a catalog, not rows.

schema.label: for
schema.description: Geography clause. Required on census_get. Example: county:* or state:06.

schema.label: get
schema.description: Comma-separated Census variables. Required on census_get. Example: NAME,B01001_001E. https://www.census.gov/data/developers/guidance/api-user-guide.html

schema.label: vintage
schema.description: Required for census_get and geography_list. Four-digit dataset year in the URL path. Example: 2010.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: census_get, geography_list.

configurationParameters.label: Key
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `query`. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 30. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
